# packet-view-checksum

行为约定：
checksum(bytes) accepts a Uint8Array (including Buffer or a subarray) and returns the sum of its visible bytes modulo 256. Bytes outside byteOffset..byteOffset+byteLength must not contribute. Empty views return 0. Do not mutate the input or backing buffer.

运行：`node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
